description: Powered by a 1250W heating element, this steam iron heats quickly to remove wrinkles with ease. Designed with a dual steam function, it offers vertical/Horizontal steam bursts for refreshing hanging clothes and drapes, while horizontal steam removes tough creases from flat garments. This makes it versatile and practical for handling different ironing needs at home. Comes with a transparent 170ml water tank that provides sufficient capacity for continuous steaming. Its easy-to-monitor design prevents overfilling and ensures hassle-free operation, allowing you to iron a pile of clothes without constant refills. A consistent 12g/min steam output penetrates deep into fabric layers, relaxing fibbers and removing creases quickly. This ensures professional-quality ironing results at home, leaving your clothes looking smooth, fresh, and ready for every occasion.
